newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bureaucrats protest in 2nd day of strike.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bureaucrats protest in 2nd day of strike.

text.p: Striking Venezuelan public servants protested Thursday in central Caracas in the second day of a 48-hour strike over the government's failure to grant promised wage increases.

Public Sector Workers Federation (Fedeunep), Carlos Borges, said the "national stoppage was total" as 400 bureaucrats shouted and waved banners in an otherwise peaceful demonstration among the country's 700,000 unionized public servants.

The government has said the strike is illegal and has blamed the delay in granting the promised average 65 percent wage increase on technical differences with Fedeunep over the deal reached in February.
Venezuela has been rocked in the past six months by a series of public sector strikes to protest real wages slashed by years of high inflation to 30 percent of 1980 levels.
